Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District is soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. The purpose of this Request for Proposal is to procure vendors who provide goods or services purchased using federal, local, state, and grant-funded programs. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District to meet minimum hardware specifications. Purchases may also include a variety of device accessories ordered in a bundle along with the devices, such as sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables. Each submission must include a detailed plan outlining tracking and deployment services, including processes for white glove services.
